title: Complete LitRPG dossier: extraordinary simple growth, scoped mastery and personal-method contracts
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete LitRPG/source-growth dossier with later simple-skill/creator/personal-method direction qualifying early prototype restrictions
reviews.disposition:
Full review covers all619 input lines: eight source references/eighteen families, casesA–F, lifecycle and six-transition matrices, five loops/watchpost/guardrails, trait and wishlist; the four equally scoped reference profiles; five combination kinds; every later simple-skill, tier/advancement, granular growth, creator/rarity, policy and incomplete-method section; and final bookshelf/engine pointers. Original source-local IDs, numerical illustrations and proof limits remain.

**Later direction already qualifies the original recommendation.** The October2 follow-up explicitly sends Jade Hollow/prototype-era statements to PROJECT rather than keeping the initial review prototype active. Subsequent user requests permit extraordinary growth of the same simple skill, levels alone where appropriate, development beyond Advanced/the creator, personal variants and incomplete methods. The saved Rat-step0–12 exercise is repeatedly scoped as an introductory content proof, not a lifetime cap or the template for every world's acquisition. The old manual-first/frontier/one-prestige build order and final “first milestone remains” statements are historical. Current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [direction](USER_VISION.md), [skills/talents](SKILLS_AND_TALENTS.md), [learning palette](SKILLS_AND_LEARNING_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-18.md) and [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) govern selected execution; no new Rat-step or Split Reed slice is launched.

**Keep the actual distinctions.** HUD convenience need not be an in-world System. An earned credential, descriptive title, mechanically granting title and public reputation have different causes. Temporary stat XP, retained aptitude, actual learned skill and copied power are not one prestige resource. Physical notes, human memory, character memory and UI planning aid can have different carriers. Same grade, same level, capacity, current command, complete instruction, latent potential and rarity answer different questions. Surpassing a creator, school or known frontier needs its own comparable objective/evidence; beating one teacher or having a stronger body proves neither universal best nor superior technique. Historical firsts stay historical while current leading status may change. A mastered fragment can remain useful even when the method is incomplete or its unknown continuation stays unknown.

**Sources are bounded.** TWI's rewritten opening is one class acquisition; Carl's premise/excerpt is not a later achievement/class economy; MoL5–6 does not establish its complete loop ontology; SSS copying's stated random card and depicted selection remain together rather than inventing a probability model. Its death-copy and recovery powers are distinct, with exact later penalty unresolved. Pinned omsi6/Proto23 source, developer store descriptions, early chapters, public excerpts and later targeted chapters have different coverage. No snippet qualifies a whole series or current deployment. The four-profile taste owner was a historical discovery source, not a current favorite/enrollment-style fact. Shadow Slave excerpts and selected creator/mastery passages support narrow comparisons, not every copying/evolution/transmission rule. All acquisition wishlists are question-led historical leads, not current missing books or authorization to collect them.

**Reconcile old safety/balance restrictions with mechanism-first direction.** Early no-death-farming, single practice/legacy slot, guaranteed alternative for every foundational method, equal usefulness, mandatory recoverable withdrawal and anti-global-XP rules are prototype choices. Later text itself allows pure stochastic advancement and says its hybrid example does not promise a deterministic alternate route to every rare power. A valid strong multiplier, free faculty, unlimited farming/retention, superior method or genuinely irreversible choice is possible through actual means under current [cheat cosmology](CHEAT_COSMOLOGY.md). Preserve actual stock, custody, committed outcomes and save integrity; do not add an anti-exploit tax or compensatory drawback. Simple numerical improvement and XP can be useful; growth need not always add a new verb or replace the familiar name. Knowledge/source transmission can directly supply execution if its actual faculty does that, rather than always requiring a new practice bar.

The novice force-capture example motivates meaningful present capacity, not a universal cap on proportional reflection, absolute protection or a capability that grows through the skill itself. Raw mana, strength and damage units are not comparable. One paid contribution must not be billed/granted twice, while independent actual effects can combine according to their mechanisms. Synergy, sequential actions, composite procedure, fusion/replacement and source-supported hybrid differ; a shared event budget is a local resource contract, not a ban on genuine separate actions or supplied reactions. Old blanket no-rank-conversion wording is qualified by supported verse equalization. Compatibility can preserve full power and does not silently reset a veteran to the novice interpretation.

**Actual events, chance and knowledge.** A qualifying use, session, experiment or resolution supplies a declared advancement opportunity; rendering, reopening or ordinary reload does not create a new event. The5%-independent-attempt example describes a distribution, not a95% success deadline or selected balance; accumulating protection, changed prerequisites and competing outcomes would change it. Routine practice can legitimately develop competence without manufacturing fresh first-discovery evidence. Active, prepared idle, assisted and absent-world advancement have separately selected policies, not a universal button or blanket prohibition on automation. Known exact odds and uncertainty follow the actor's means; the proposed display cannot reveal hidden faculties or falsely label missing fuel as an incomplete manuscript.

**Engineering and evidence limits.** Old module names, expansion schema3, base.frontier bindings, public-source behavior and54-test references are dated observations, not today's feature gaps or passing combined game. A new knowledge/specialization namespace, generated tradition, acquisition method or ability description is not implemented by declaring fields or prose. Reuse actual [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), XP, subject identity, publication, clocks and reward owners. Unknown authorship stays unknown; new saves do not acquire invented past encounters, creators or faculties. Threshold grants, variant retention, copied versus transferred ownership and ordinary XP require their selected settlement/compatibility rules. AD36/AD43 and current optional human review govern implementation proof; source-only models and conversation explorers retain their unrun scope.

Reopen a named family/profile/combination or personal-method condition for an authorized actual consumer and relevant source/runtime evidence. No novel/PDF, current library/favorites, source code, primary corpus, gameplay test/build/browser, personal save, acquisition, deletion, relocation, commit or push was newly performed.
